record.field: Verify your email to finish setting up Dayflow

field.name: body_html
field.p: Thanks for signing up for Dayflow. Please confirm your email address to activate your account:

a.style: padding: 8px 16px; background-color: #3b6ef6; color: #fff; border-radius: 4px; text-decoration: none;

field.p: If you did not request this account, you can ignore this email.

record.field: Your Dayflow HR access request was approved

field.name: body_html
field.p: Your request for HR / Admin access on Dayflow has been approved. You now have access to the HR dashboard, employee records and approvals.

record.field: Your Dayflow HR access request was not approved

field.name: body_html
field.p: Your request for HR / Admin access on Dayflow was not approved. You still have full access as an Employee. Contact your administrator if you believe this is a mistake.
